title: Tokenless SDK onboarding: compact visuals for auth, streaming & tool-call wiring
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact set of onboarding illustrations and annotated screenshots that explain a tokenless (ephemeral-key) SDK init flow, streaming handshake, and tool-call wiring. Assets should be optimized for: 1) a two-column quickstart page (hero + steps), 2) micro-animations for the docs site, and 3) a single-page one-sheet used in the Console onboarding modal. Focus on clarity for engineers: sequence diagrams, minimal code snippets, and callout annotations for failure/fallback states. Avoid duplicating existing 'credential card' artwork; produce a fresh visual language with thin stroke icons, a muted color palette, and keyboard/code chrome that matches the SDK docs theme.
acceptance_criteria: Three static assets: hero overview (1200x560), streaming handshake strip (900x300), tool-call wiring diagram (1000x600)
Two Lottie-ready micro-animations: auth step transition, streaming chunk delivery (export-ready JSON)
Figma prototype link with version history and component tokens (no missing images)
Design reviewed and signed off by PM and Engineering (review comments resolved)
Final exports pushed to Drive in PNG/SVG/WebP and design tokens exported for docs site
